notes.title: Join GameLooper Online Workshop for FREE! (Limited Seats Available)
notes.content:
Learn to Make Astonishing Mobile Games in Less than 2 Hours with Award-Winning Gamelooper!

 Follow this link on this Saturday, April 30th 2016, at 13:00 PST and join us to create great mobile games with GameLooper. 

As featured on Steam, Gamelooper has become one of the industry leader gaming platforms in a short period of time with over 100,000 downloads. Gamelooper makes it super easy to create amazing mobile games with its free to use tool.

Now, you have a chance to join our live course where you will be creating an astonishing mobile game within two hours. At the end of the course: we will select Gamelooper masters who will exclusively be trained to become game masters as a profession. You will also have the opportunity to have your app published in the App Store and Google Play for free.

Here you can find one of our game masters blog explaining his experience with Gamelooper. https://stuffbyrabassa.com/games-in-progress/

Data & Time: Saturday, April 30th 2016, at 13:00 PST
Link: https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/6586044238300014850

notes.title: Tueples – The first GameLooper Game is published
notes.content:
Today is a special day!

One of our beloved users,  Richard Rabassa, has created a game called “Tueples” by using GameLooper, and as of today it is on the  App Store  and  Google Play.


Tueples is a level based colorful game of quick reflexes. Aim is to capture the crazy Tueples as they dance around and drag them into the vortex before the timer runs out.
You  need to be precise to catch the moving Tueples and quick to catch enough of them. Time is running.
There are 10 different Tueples to choose from. Coins are waiting to be catched in the game to unlock them.
You should look for the powerups when they appear. One of them makes the Tueples easy to catch, other one provides extra time.


We congratulate Richard and invite all of you to play Tueples for free.
